programme.title: 林則徐 虎門銷煙以外
programme.desc: 2025年，適逢民族英雄林則徐誕辰二百四十周年國家主席習近平在福州任職期間，保育了林則徐出生地的一系列遺跡他先後多次引用林則徐苟利國家生死以，豈因禍福避趨之的名句，號召國人把林則徐的民族精神和優秀品格繼承發揚下去ampampampltbrampampampgt林則徐：虎門銷煙以外是一部由香港電台出品的五集歷史人文紀錄片影片以香港視角出發，跨越三萬公里深入中國多省市（包括澳門廣東湖南福建浙江河南陝西甘肅新疆），更東渡日本，探尋虎門銷煙之外那個更為真實立體的林則徐ampampampltbrampampampgt林則徐虎門銷煙的壯舉固然永載史冊，但其光輝遠不止於此本紀錄片突破傳統敘事框架，不僅回顧林則徐虎門銷煙的功績，更深入挖掘他作為治水能臣嚴謹學者流放者與思想家的多面人生透過實地探訪專家訪談，並結合AI技術生成動畫重現歷史場景，影片呈現林則徐在禁煙海防水利邊疆開發等方面的卓越貢獻，並揭示其開眼看世界的深遠影響節目以細膩的鏡頭語言和情感敘述，串聯歷史與當下，展現林則徐精神的當代意義，值此民族英雄誕辰二百四十周年之際，向他獻上最誠摯的敬意本片由ampampamplt香港電台ampampampgt贈播

programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.desc: 장애나 희귀병으로 고통받는 아이들과, 가난 때문에 치료를 포기 해야만 하는 위기에 처한 가정을 찾아가, 전문의, 심리학자, 상담사, 건축설계사 등 국내 최고의 전문가 그룹이 장애를 앓고 있는 어린이와 그 가정의 회복을 목표로 전문적이고 구체적인 해결 방안을 제시해준다 치료와 재활을 적극적으로 도와주는 솔루션 프로그램.

programme.desc: 수십년간 한 분야에 종사하며 부단한 열정과 노력으로 달인의 경지에 이르게 된 사람들. 삶의 스토리와 리얼리티가 담겨 있는 생활 달인은 그 자체가 다큐멘터리. 비록 소박한 일이지만 평생을 통해 최고가 된 생활 달인의 놀라운 득도의 경지를 만나는 시간.

광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 어린이들 사이에서 최고의 인기를 자랑하고 있는 바닷속 네모난 친구는 누구일까요? 기상천외하고 유쾌하면서도 매력만점의 주인공 스폰지밥을 만나보세요! 저 깊은 태평양 바닷속, 비키니 씨티라는 해저도시에는 네모낳고 노란 해면동물 스폰지밥과 친구들이 있습니다. 스폰지밥은 애완동물인 달팽이 핑핑이와 함께 파인애플 집에 살고 있습니다. 스폰지밥의 장기는 정말 맛있는 음식을 척척 만들어 내는 멋쟁이 요리사라는 점과 언제나 모든 소동과 사건의 현장에 있다는 것입니다! 괴팍한 이웃 친구 징징이를 괴롭히는 것도 스폰지밥의 또다른 특기죠. 스폰지밥의 단짝 친구는 솔직하고 사랑스러운 불가사리 뚱이, 그리고 스릴만점의 모험을 즐기는 여자친구인 다람이입니다. 꿈과 환상의 도시인 비키니 시티 에서는 물고기 친구들이 걸어다니고, 게살버거가 가장 맛있는 음식은 이라고 하네요. 지금 바로 바닷속에 뛰어들어서 스폰지밥의 매력에 흠뻑 젖어보세요!

programme.desc: 經典男團Lollipop棒棒堂6位大男孩敖犬小煜威廉阿緯小杰王子，16年後終於合體聚首接下所有困難與挑戰

programme.title: 奔跑吧玫瑰首
programme.desc: 含著金湯匙出生的薔薇因父親驟逝而失去一切，在面臨丈夫背叛與生活重擔的考驗下，堅強重獲新生，並與大企業繼承人譜出浪漫戀曲的勵志愛情故事

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 李昇基李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！改編自人氣網路小說，怪物天才檢察官金正浩與韓國小姐出身律師金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營Law Caf的故事既是律師事務所又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開

programme.title: 韶華若錦

programme.title: 一字千金妙筆生花風雲榜新
programme.desc: 一字千金鬥字益智節目，廣邀同中有異職業和身分的來賓，展開一連串矛與盾的對決，一起領略中華文字之美！

programme.title: 華麗計程車行
programme.desc: 嘉義的華麗車行裡，陳柏文大學畢業陳柏翰志願役退伍，兩兄弟正面臨要走入職場或接班計程車行的人生分岔路口兄弟倆觀察著為車行奔走交際的爸爸-阿三哥，喬車主喬事的媽媽-董娘，以及從小進出自家一樓車行的司機們，在面對處理不完的負債與呆帳難以言語的家庭心結不被社會認同的悲哀，卻也都有著永不服輸堅持到底的傻勁，握緊方向盤，相信只要車子往前跑，就沒有解決不了的問題做個快樂的甘苦人，更要完成人生這趟華麗的旅程

programme.title: 龍馬精神
programme.desc: 昔日風光的龍虎武師老羅（成龍飾），如今窮困潦倒，與他的愛馬赤兔相依為命，在片場靠著跑龍套過日子老羅一心想將赤兔培養成動作巨星，然而天外飛來橫禍，老羅與赤兔無端身陷官司，只能求助於多年未見的女兒小寶與其律師男友乃華與此同時，有人上傳了老羅與討債集團的追逐戰影片，精彩的武打動作在網路瘋傳，老羅更獲得拍電影的機會，女兒小寶還幫忙當起了製作人，試圖為老羅與赤兔爭取最好的動作舞台

programme.title: 熊貓計劃
programme.desc: 功夫巨星成龍收養了融化人心的熊貓寶寶呼呼，然而呼呼的可愛魅力讓國際犯罪組織首領祭出一億美金，只為了將呼呼搶為己有！新手奶爸成龍只得和金牌經紀人及熊貓保育員聯手，三個臭皮匠決心一起守護呼呼沒想到這場史無前例的救援行動卻有出乎意料的發展，一場為了超可愛寶貝奮戰的驚險冒險就此展開！

programme.title: 唐伯虎點秋香
programme.desc: 姑蘇唐伯虎（周星馳飾）文名遠播某日，唐伯虎在大廟中遇見華夫人及侍婢秋香（鞏俐），一見傾心，不惜以假身分華安賣身葬父入華府為僕豈知華夫人因故痛恨唐家，並對華安之來歷起疑，幾經波折後終於識破其真實身分為唐伯虎，但仍心存刁難，且看唐伯虎能否在一班蒙面新娘中點中秋香

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: 狄仁傑大破神都龍王案，獲御賜亢龍鐧，並掌管大理寺，使他成為武則天走向權力之路最大的威脅同時，洛陽城發生諸多離奇事件面對空前危機，狄仁傑要如何保住亢龍鐧？

programme.title: 古董局中局
programme.desc: 來自日本的木戶加奈小姐即將歸還中國一尊唐代武則天時期的明堂佛頭，指明要文物界組織五脈旗下白字門許家後人出面接收有著一身鑒古天賦的許家後人許願，在黃煙煙勸說下，他不情願的前往交涉，卻敏銳地察覺到佛頭是贗品許願本想逃避，然而面對重重迷霧和威脅，已是身不由己他必須要在各方勢力的糾纏之下，查明真相

programme.title: 人潮洶湧
programme.desc: 小劇場演員陳小萌的人生窮困潦倒，事業一敗塗地，有一天，他去澡堂泡澡，竟意外的讓殺手周全摔倒失憶，演員和殺手交換了身分，從醫院醒來的殺手失去記憶，誤以為自己是走投無路的演員，在偶然結識的單親媽媽李想的幫助下，他重新認識作為演員的自己，探索前進的方向，在這過程中他和李想的內心也悄悄發生變化

programme.title: 水滸笑傳
programme.desc: 顛覆水滸傳中武松的英雄形象！武松原乃膽小莽夫一名，但每當酒過三巡，便生出一身蠻力神勇無匹其兄武大郎與潘金蓮是一對鴛鴦大盜，以仙人跳為生無往而不利一日武大郎在街上遇到西門慶，欲故計重施而推薦潘金蓮，又恐生性正直的武松礙事，遂唆使潘金蓮用計趕走武松

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山間，一僧一道比鄰而居和尚隨和開朗，有一女徒菁菁玲瓏可愛；道士古板嚴厲，徒弟嘉樂卻鬼馬頑皮性格不同的兩個師傅口角不斷，兩個冤家徒弟也笑料頻出某天，一支邊疆皇族屍隊路過此地，遭遇暴雨雷劈，殭屍破棺而出，大開殺戒烏侍郎攜王子僥倖逃命，但王子已中屍毒和尚與道士命徒兒照看王子，兩人則衝入樹林尋找千鶴道長

programme.title: 神話
programme.desc: 秦朝玉漱公主頻頻入夢，困擾著考古學家杰克，使他更醉心研究秦朝古物為解開夢境之謎，杰克來到西安的懸浮天宮，同時亦有各路高手為奪寶而來，天宮寶物被撬開，天空之城因而失去懸浮能力，成千上萬的兵馬俑從天而降，杰克受一股神秘力量牽引跳入萬丈瀑布睜開雙眼，出現的竟然是夢中人玉漱公主！

programme.title: 青面修羅
programme.desc: 因一塊藏寶銅片慘遭滅門的青面修羅齊君元，在神秘刺客組織離恨谷長大某日離恨谷受託奪取藏寶銅片，谷主卻未派齊君元追查，但齊君元決意復仇，不惜叛谷暗自出馬調查血案消失多年的銅片為何再現？面對各路高手追殺捲入兩國鬥爭，齊君元發現自己已身陷局中，設局者是何方神聖？神秘委託人又是何許人也？

programme.title: 掃毒3：人在天涯
programme.desc: 國際販毒集團毒梟康素差一直帶著手下張建行等人從事毒品交易，新加入集團的成員歐志遠也因一次意外，與兩人建立了過命交情，三人情同手足康素差在香港的販毒生意突然被警方查獲，他帶著團隊逃到金三角發展，積極籠絡當地的土皇帝戴金榮，計劃兩人聯手擴大勢力，讓自己東山再起，卻意外發現身邊藏有臥底此刻，是敵是友，一片茫然

programme.title: 賞金獵人
programme.desc: 李山來歷不明，但擁有超強武打能力阿YO智慧過人，曾任國際刑警機緣巧合下，才貌兼備的Cat天才駭客Swan和力量超凡的Bobo也加入了他們的公司一天他們接到任務，眾人兵分兩路查探懷疑藏有炸彈的濟州島A酒店他們目標是揪出近期在A酒店發生的連環爆炸案的始作俑者

programme.title: 通天神探狄仁傑
programme.desc: 武則天登基前正在興建高達百米的通天浮屠，此時發生接二連三的駭人自焚案，且死者皆為朝廷權貴武后聽從國師指示，召回神探狄仁傑查案，命為欽差，並派上官靜兒裴東協助兼監視狄仁傑狄仁傑聽從舊日同僚沙陀建議，深入鬼市探查線索卻反遭追殺，隨著案情逐漸明朗，所有證據竟都直指武后本人

programme.title: 驚天盜數
programme.desc: 維克多是一名小偷，俄羅斯黑幫成員希望他執行一樁搶案，然而維克多對這群新朋友的銀行搶劫計畫並不放心就在眾人準備下手時，國際刑警組織的特工殺死了黑幫成員並逮捕維克多，而負責搶案的司機毒蟲拉沛多卻在維克多的協助下逃走事實上維克多是名臥底警察，但隨著臥底行動終止而被吊銷職位並面臨調查，在心灰意冷之際，維克多決定沿用黑幫計劃，與拉沛多一起搶劫銀行

programme.title: 野性獵殺
programme.desc: 特種部隊退役的法蘭克以販賣野生動物為業，某日他在巴西捕獲了一隻兇猛罕見的白色美洲豹沒想到船運過程中，碰上美國國安局正押解危險重刑犯洛夫勒，洛夫勒逃脫國安局的監控，並釋放船上所有的野生動物，法蘭克必須設法活捉美洲豹，還得協助美國政府捉拿洛夫勒，一場船上惡戰即將展開

programme.title: 露西亞的願望：魔法時光機
programme.desc: 聖誕老人學校校長宣布取消聖誕節，所有人為之震驚！校長陷入年輕時當聖誕老人的創傷中露西亞希望回到過去，拯救聖誕節，而擁有魔法時光機的伊利亞斯也出手相助她穿越時空來到1897年，一個天堂般的馬戲團烏鴉巢，孩子在此擺脫父母的束縛搞笑的馮雷文統治馬戲團，但他似乎不像看起來那麼真誠

programme.title: 超時空救難小英雄
programme.desc: 寒假期間，愛吵架的兩兄弟鼻涕和水花，搭火車前往偏遠小鎮探望他們的奶奶卻在抵達的時候，發現一切都變了樣！兩兄弟展開調查，發現小鎮和居民都面臨危機，於是他們開始追捕一名神秘的偷洞小偷最終，這對年輕英雄不僅拯救了小鎮，還拯救了其他地方事實上，他們拯救了全世界避免被一個巨大的黑洞給吞噬！

programme.title: 36總局
programme.desc: 巴黎街頭出現一群窮凶惡極的匪徒，犯下多起血腥暴力的攻擊事件，警方卻遲遲抓不到兇手警界盛傳只要將這幫惡人緝拿歸案，就能接替巴黎刑警局局長之大位而警局裡最有勝算的兩大警探，里奧為求破案不惜包庇線人，卻意外捲入謀殺案；丹尼則因過於服從上級，導致隊友因公殉職激烈的爭權鬥勢，讓他們兩人迷失在道德邊界，這場權力戰爭將何去何從？

programme.title: 叛諜檔案
programme.desc: 前任美國中情局CIA成員韋爾本可享受退休後的清閒時光，卻被嫁禍於一樁國外記者謀殺案件中脫不了身能力高超的他，在美國成為各國眼中釘的情況下，被迫回歸CIA，只為了釐清嫌疑，殊不知此舉讓他深陷更危險的陰謀當中

programme.title: 劫獄救援
programme.desc: 職業罪犯紅髮艾達沃克在25年的服刑期間與絕症搏鬥，時日不多在艾達的指導下，她的兒子懷特沃克繼承了家業，而懷特的叔叔達拉斯沃克則從旁協助他他們預謀一場搶案來拯救艾達然而，在某次出差錯時，當地警探同時也是懷特姊夫的柏迪柯萊，連同FBI調查官羅倫斯泰利一起追查背後的主使究竟懷特他們能否成功完成解救任務，讓母親在剩餘的生命裡重返自由呢？

programme.title: 毀滅倒數首
programme.desc: 不久的未來，漂泊的太空人大衛，正在外太空進行例行氣候視察一場失控的意外，讓大衛與太空船及地球指揮中心失去聯繫而此時的地球，機器人與人工智慧已經成為人們生活的好夥伴；科技的快速發展，讓人們可以重返並編輯自己過去的記憶租借身體，甚至高階的人類，更可以選擇讓自己長生不老只是，當仰賴的科技變成真實夢魘，世界即將在十分鐘內毀滅，人們還能掌控自己想要的未來嗎？

programme.title: 空孢戰
programme.desc: 駐紮在月球上的太空船意外遭到隕石撞擊，船員發現來自隕石上的孢子正快速突變再生，女性太空人居然快速懷孕並產下駭人生物，失控的氛圍蔓延整艘太空船，面臨變形怪物大開殺戒，他們該如何自保求生？

programme.title: 終結戰
programme.desc: 一位項上人頭遭到懸賞的年輕美國警察為了替亡師報仇血恨，與一名泰國傭兵聯手合作當他發現自己正與該國最惡名昭彰的冷酷罪犯正面交峰時，他的任務轉瞬之間變得無比凶險

programme.title: 星際特工瓦雷諾：千星之城
programme.desc: 盧貝松執導科幻作品瓦雷諾與蘿琳娜是時空旅行特務的精英成員，他們不斷在時間與空間中穿梭，維護28世紀的世界秩序兩位特工搭檔意外捲入巨大的星際陰謀，從而引發一場關乎7000多個宇宙種族存亡之戰

programme.title: 潛艦追緝
programme.desc: 被法國海軍封為地表最強千里耳的尚特雷，以超敏銳的聽覺讓海軍弟兄們免於無數次的潛艦危機在敘利亞海域的任務中，卻出現他此生從未聽過也無法分辨的聲軌，隨著聲音漸漸逼近，竟讓潛艦暴露了行蹤，引爆了深海危機；與此同時，法國與俄羅斯的國際情勢逐漸上漲，竟有一顆核彈朝向法國而來，即將成為引爆第三次世界大戰的導火線！

programme.title: 波伽利：聲命之歌
programme.desc: 阿莫斯生來就擁有美妙嗓音，卻因為先天性眼疾進入盲人學校，之後又在一場足球比賽意外後完全失明個性好強的他，卻從未因此放棄自己對音樂的熱情與夢想在恩師（安東尼奧班德拉斯飾）的嚴厲指導下，他的歌唱技巧不斷提升與突破，終於獲得義大利國寶級搖滾明星蘇奇洛賞識，親自邀他同台獻唱，此後開始朝史上最成功的跨界男高音之路邁進

programme.title: 美聲歌雞
programme.desc: 圖魯是一隻相貌古怪且不會下蛋的母雞，因此遭到其他母雞的嘲笑和排擠曾是音樂老師的老奶奶伊莎貝爾非常喜歡圖魯，她將圖魯帶到自己的農場，竟意外發現圖魯的獨特天賦她不僅能夠跟人類說話，還有著美麗的動人歌聲，但伊莎貝爾害怕其他人會利用圖魯的天賦賺錢，於是決定守住這個秘密某天，伊莎貝爾從屋頂上摔下來而且失去了記憶，隨後被救護車送往醫院；想念老奶奶的圖魯決定踏上旅程尋找她珍貴的好友！

programme.title: 即刻救援
programme.desc: 退休特務布萊恩在與赴歐洲旅遊的愛女小琴通越洋電話時，親耳聽到小琴慘遭人口販子綁架，最強老爸將憑藉特務經驗及施展過人身手，追擊人口販子並親自救回掌上明珠！

programme.title: 星光首映場毀滅倒數
programme.desc: 不久的未來，漂泊的太空人大衛，正在外太空進行例行氣候視察一場失控的意外，讓大衛與太空船及地球指揮中心失去聯繫而此時的地球，機器人與人工智慧已經成為人們生活的好夥伴；科技的快速發展，讓人們可以重返並編輯自己過去的記憶租借身體，甚至高階的人類，更可以選擇讓自己長生不老只是，當仰賴的科技變成真實夢魘，世界即將在十分鐘內毀滅，人們還能掌控自己想要的未來嗎？

programme.title: 狂沙十萬里
programme.desc: 冷血殺手法蘭克神秘復仇客口琴仔美麗寡婦吉兒盜賊頭頭夏安，四人各為不同理由原因來到這處鐵路即將開通的西部荒漠甜水鎮鐵路大亨莫頓為取得鐵道用地，在甜水鎮大興風浪，在現代鐵路西進的歷史洪流中，上演新一輪腥風血雨的美國西部開拓史

programme.title: 美國天堂
programme.desc: 1951年，匈牙利陷入軍閥割據的全民恐慌，從事出版的彼得與瑪姬夫婦名列清算名單，他們逃亡至美國，卻無法帶走小女兒蘇珊平安抵達後，瑪姬不斷寫信向美國政府求情，只盼見到女兒全家團圓蘇珊由鄉間一對好心夫婦撫養長大，這天，城裡的奶奶要帶蘇珊進城玩，蘇珊將搭上飛往美國的班機，那裡有苦心企盼與她團聚的親生父母與嶄新生活小小年紀的蘇珊沒得選擇，美國不是她的家；她的心，始終遺留在遙遠的匈牙利

programme.title: 大進擊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，英國轟炸中隊於巴黎上空執行轟炸任務，其中一架轟炸機被德軍擊中，飛行員被迫跳傘逃生，並約好在清真寺旁的土耳其浴室會合其中三名英軍分別降落在動物園水池歌劇院，以及正在重新粉刷的納粹祕密警察總部屋頂，在動物園管理員歌劇院樂團指揮與油漆工幫助下逃生而樂團指揮和油漆工，更陰錯陽差隨著三名英軍飛行員，與德軍展開了一場場驚險刺激的逃亡之旅！

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 包龍星買了一個縣令官職，他愛上的美女秦氏卻嫁給一位富商數月後，戚秦氏因絕世美貌遭水師提督常昆之子常威染指，戚家當晚慘遭滅門，首要凶嫌戚秦氏被刑求入獄待秋後處斬包龍星則被迫拔官，淪落至一妓院做龜公，因緣際會結識微服出遊之皇帝，被封為八府巡按後回鄉重審此案，號稱白面包青天，終將常威就地正法，戚秦氏沈冤得雪

programme.title: 黃昏雙鏢客
programme.desc: 獨來獨往的大鏢客蒙哥又來了，這次出現了一位可敬的競爭對手北卡羅萊納州的神槍手退役上校莫迪默同為賞金獵人的倆人，為了追捕最高賞金的印迪奧犯罪集團而開始明爭暗鬥，卻無人能得手，最後兩人只好合作緝捕印迪奧集團

programme.title: 第一爐香
programme.desc: 上海女學生葛薇龍（馬思純飾）來香港求學，投靠姑媽梁太太（俞飛鴻飾），卻反被梁太太利用，將她當作誘餌吸引男人，葛薇龍漸漸沉溺在紙醉金迷中後來她被花花公子喬琪喬（彭于晏飾）吸引，為求繼續聲色犬馬的上流社會生活，不惜出賣自己的靈魂，費盡心機嫁給了喬琪喬，然最終卻淪為姑媽梁太太和喬琪喬斂財的工具

programme.title: 五月的35日
programme.desc: 1940年，德軍佔領法國，從事記者工作的路德維希與他年僅12歲的兒子洛弗為了逃避納粹政府的通緝，已經在法國馬賽流亡三年，計畫帶著愛犬阿迪逃離歐洲前往紐約與妻子會合途中，兩人認識了與洛弗差不多大的牧羊女諾麗雅兒，三人一狗踏上了佈滿危險的未知旅程多項國際影展獲獎提名

programme.title: 大洪荒
programme.desc: 公元前百萬年的遠古時代，高原洞穴中的岩石部落，首領阿可荷巴的次子托馬克因不服父親搶奪自己的食物而遭驅逐，流浪至海邊被較文明的貝殼族所救他因奮勇擊退巨獸而為貝殼族所擁戴，並受該族美女羅安納仰慕，而後率領貝殼族人歷經千辛萬苦回到岩石部落，卻人事已非其兄長沙卡納謀害父親並繼任成為新的首領，而高原上的火山也即將爆發

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒
programme.desc: 滿清年間，旗人子弟蘇察哈爾燦目不識丁揮霍成性為贏得丐幫美女如霜芳心，決定上京考武狀元蘇父買通考官由師爺代筆考中武狀元，但被臥底宮中之天理教教主趙無忌揭發舞弊皇帝怒將燦父子貶為乞丐流落街頭，燦又遭趙無忌打成殘廢後燦偶遇丐幫長老洪日慶授以睡夢羅漢拳，如霜被趙無忌擄走，燦以睡夢羅漢拳奪得幫主之位，率眾迎戰造反之趙無忌，終於領悟降龍十八掌

programme.title: 血染雪山堡
programme.desc: 二戰中期盟軍重要人物－美國卡納比將軍，座機在德奧邊界墜毀被俘，就近被囚禁在阿爾卑斯山中地勢險惡的鷹堡英國軍情六處特納上校立即派遣以特工史密斯少校為首與美軍謝弗中尉等精通德語的七人突擊隊，假扮德軍深入敵營搶救但在空降時通訊士意外喪命，不久又有兩名成員離奇身亡，更離譜的是謝弗中尉從史密斯少校口中得知，卡納比將軍竟是由演員所扮演！這艱鉅的鷹堡搶救任務，究竟還隱藏著甚麼更大的陰謀？

programme.title: 報告班長3
programme.desc: 在一次突擊式的模擬軍事演習中，蘇班長率小穎等眾兵戍海岸線，準備殲滅登陸的藍軍，不料小穎誤觸引爆炸藥的按鈕，而將演習弄得一團亂，全連也因此被派赴基地再訓練負責訓練的屠班長暗下決定，一切要從頭開始烏龍班終於在營裡舉行成果驗收之日，展現最亮麗的一面，也在五項戰技測驗中為連長奪下一面獎牌

programme.title: 古董局中局
programme.desc: 來自日本的木戶加奈小姐即將歸還中國一尊唐代武則天時期的明堂佛頭，指明要文物界組織五脈旗下白字門許家後人出面接收有著一身鑒古天賦的許家後人許願，在黃煙煙勸說下，他不情願的前往交涉，卻敏銳地察覺到佛頭是贗品許願本想逃避，然而面對重重迷霧和威脅，已是身不由己他必須要在各方勢力的糾纏之下，查明真相

programme.title: 藍徽特攻隊
programme.desc: 一戰末期德軍在西部前線戰事吃緊，畢業於104飛行學校的史達赫中尉來到了威利上尉的飛行中隊當時飛行員最高榮譽是擊落敵機二十架可獲頒藍色徽章史達赫在首次任務就擊落英軍飛機一架，卻未得到陸軍證實而不算，但史達赫的戰功並未因此停滯不前；最終，史達赫榮獲最高榮譽，卻在授予藍色勳章那天，有人向元帥爆料史達赫紀錄不實的內幕，中隊長決定把他送至柏林軍事法庭究責

programme.title: 猛龍過江
programme.desc: 武功高強的唐龍，受朋友所託遠赴歐洲協助解決一家餐館的業權問題，遇上黑幫搗亂及威迫，並恥笑中國拳術，唐大怒出手把洋人打得抱頭鼠竄，黑幫首領大為震怒，最後請來美國國際空手道冠軍，與唐龍決一死戰

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 無雙樓掌廚 四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館無雙樓他收下四名徒弟南花西紅東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團花花食界由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟無雙宴，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情

programme.title: 整形過後--慾望與認同新
programme.desc: 台灣首部整形醫療影集整形過後，整的不只是臉，而是心！！華麗卻殘酷的醫美產業，揭開變美的創傷與代價技術頂尖卻內心破碎的整形外科醫師江浩宇，遇上正直倔強從公立醫院轉來的楊雅頌，被迫直視醫療倫理與八年前未解的傷痛兩人與診所執行長蘇菲，交織出情感與權力的拉扯一樁樁醫美案例浮上檯面，被控制的女星術後猝死的公關非法醫療與重建自我的病人，不斷拷問真正的治療是什麼這是一段關於修復放下與重生的故事

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.desc: 全台首播心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.title: 整形過後--慾望與認同
programme.desc: 台灣首部整形醫療影集整形過後，整的不只是臉，而是心！！華麗卻殘酷的醫美產業，揭開變美的創傷與代價技術頂尖卻內心破碎的整形外科醫師江浩宇，遇上正直倔強從公立醫院轉來的楊雅頌，被迫直視醫療倫理與八年前未解的傷痛兩人與診所執行長蘇菲，交織出情感與權力的拉扯一樁樁醫美案例浮上檯面，被控制的女星術後猝死的公關非法醫療與重建自我的病人，不斷拷問真正的治療是什麼這是一段關於修復放下與重生的故事

programme.title: 女人要有錢
programme.desc: 知名女作家吳淡如，以她知性且深入人心的形象，攜手專業寶物鑑定團隊，帶領觀眾走進藝人名人貴婦及素人家中，鑑賞他們珍藏的寶物及收藏品節目將通過生動的賞寶過程，向觀眾傳授基礎的賞寶知識，讓大家在輕鬆愉快的氛圍中，學會如何鑑定家中的寶物究竟這些珍藏能否讓你一夜致富，還是讓你瞬間崩盤？敬請鎖定，一同探索古今寶物的奧秘！

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 無雙樓掌廚 四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館無雙樓他收下四名徒弟南花西紅東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團花花食界由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟無雙宴，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情

programme.title: 只屬於我的你雙語版
programme.desc: 渣男律師劈腿富豪千金 李敏英逆襲成知名設計師恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: MOD首播怪力媽搭配毒舌女 母女笑鬧同居火花不斷一個是凡事衝動毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性走自己路的女兒原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常從降職的糗事誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方這場陌生人同居記，意外寫下母女間最爆笑最暖心的篇章

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 歐若拉公主

programme.desc: 母親宣布卒婚引發家庭風暴 父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開母親突然宣佈要卒婚，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密像外人一樣的家人間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The annual harvest fair and the daredevil riders of the Wall of Death arrive in the Midsomer village of Whitcombe Mallet. But when the owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his horse, DCI Barnaby and DS Nelson, along with the expertise of forensic pathologist Kam Karimore, must unravel a complex feud from the past. However, nothing is as it seems, and they are in a race against time as they work to solve the case. Detective drama, starring Neil Dudgeon, Gwilym Lee, Manjinder Virk and Fiona Dolman

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Christmas special of the detective drama from 2016. The village of Little Auburn has stood abandoned since the Second World War, but now plans are afoot to restore it to its former glory via three competing projects. It is left to local landowner Roderick Craven to determine which scheme will win out, but on the eve of his big decision, one of the project leaders is murdered. DCI Barnaby and his new partner DS Jamie Winter are soon on the case, and when death stalks the streets of Little Auburn again, Barnaby and Winter are dragged into a web of conspiracy involving fraud, deadly snakes, and Rodericks estranged brother, Milo guest star Hugh Dennis. Neil Dudgeon stars, with Nick Hendrix making his debut as Barnabys latest assistant

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Angus, a member of the Bleakridge Watch, a group of villagers who walk the streets reporting anyone who falls foul of the law, is found dead in his meat freezer. Barnaby and Winter meet Anguss devastated sister and her daughter and learn that Angus was investigating a recent spate of burglaries in the village, but had yet to identify the culprit. Angus post-mortem reveals strange restraining injuries on his wrists and the plot thickens as Barnaby discovers just how far some people will go for power. Frances Barber guest stars as the leader of the Watch

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: The detective is called to the University of Northumberland when Jamie Marshall, a promising young journalism student, falls to his death from the top of a disused faculty building. With no eyewitnesses and no immediate leads, Vera turns to friends and family to glean all she can about Jamie, and to discover who might have wanted him dead. The students innocent facade is revealed to have concealed simmering resentment and anger which he expressed on the internet - and which may have made him some deadly enemies

programme.title: Inspector Morse

programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloes, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Rug Island
programme.desc: On Bingo and Blueys Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything: bananas, campfires, even a snake. But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

programme.title: Andy and the European Hamster
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer to Vienna, Austria, on a global adventure to solve the mystery of an animal behaving strangely in a churchyard. Along the way, Andy meets a wild European hamster with a taste for flowers and candle wax.

programme.title: Andy and the Pallass Cats
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout embark on a global adventure to Mongolia in eastern Asia to uncover the mystery of moving rocks, only to discover its a mother Pallass cat out hunting for her kittens. Along the way, Andy takes a ride with a Bactrian camel.

programme.title: The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - its King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that finding their talents means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They dont understand what hes doing and think its funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. Why do my feet hurt?, he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them why is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: Its news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if hes got any news at all, remembers hes getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and thats what shes supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Eugenes Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his fathers death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiance enlists a swordsmanwho secretly loves herto search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a polices son, blames his father for his mothers death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the Full Moon Scimitar, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hons pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh Glass Tears, Killer Clans and Shi Szu Lovers Destiny, who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they cant escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Changs. On the Changs farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Taos real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly Iron Fist technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her familys objection, so Hongs maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the schools stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Caos enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Beis concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the others true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: God of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: After the God of Gamblers Ko Chun disappears, his disciple Little Knife rises in the gambling world. His fame attracts a ruthless rival who seeks to defeat him. Facing high-stakes games, Little Knife must rely on his skills to overcome his enemies and defend the honour of the God of Gamblers.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Lis daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Clouds successor as the citys guard.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandoras Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee aka. Li Hsiu-hsien as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Big Story
programme.desc: Big Story is a documentary film program on CGTN. It explores global events with in a variety of filmic styles and featuring original, in-depth, thought-provoking storytelling. The program provides a unique platform for the best current affairs documentaries from around the globe. Big Story aims to present the contemporary world and Chinas global perspectives on the contemporary world to an international audience.

programme.desc: 综艺新时代，发现台湾好所在三位主持秉持主持职人的精神，以诙谐搞笑的方式，到台湾368个乡镇走透透，把台湾各地专业职人为台湾这片土地所做的努力介绍给观众Spanning all 368 townships of Taiwan, this lively trio shines a light on local craftsmenmasters of their trade whose passion, grit, and love for the land reveal the islands truest charm.

programme.title: 追分成功Define Your Own Success
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, whos honing her survival skills in Brazils Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Watch sea lion Lola take her first chaotic steps into a macho battlefield on Argentinas coast. Cheer as this baby learns key vocal and swimming skills, fights to stay by mom Marias side, and makes a lightning-fast escape from the jaws of death.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Feel the enchantment of Brazils Atlantic Forest as southern muriqui Dora takes her first steps away from mum Mimi. Get lessons in spider monkey troop dynamics, bone up on tail-hanging technique, and see this baby find her place among her peers.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Set a course for adventure with Thiago, a brave baby coati. Find out how this raccoon-like fellow sharpens his sniffing and foraging skills, crosses suburban roads near his lush Brazilian forest home, and avoids inanimate and four-legged dangers.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Visit the last stronghold of the giant river otter in Brazils beautiful Pantanal wetland. Track pup Rio and his siblings as they test the waters, team up to evade a jaguar ambush, and become a cohesive family unit that hunts and thrives together.

programme.title: Weird, Wild Wonderful
programme.desc: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

programme.title: 中国缘Bond with China
programme.desc: 中国缘是中央广播电视总台华语环球节目中心的大型跨文化纪实故事节目，每期30分钟，节目从中外结缘的视角，深度讲述中国融通世界的故事通过节目向世界展现真实立体全面的中国，传播中华文化，体现开放包容自强不息的中华精神，同时展现地球村中人与人的关系，展现世界各地的风土人情和多样文明，以更好地促进联接中外沟通世界

programme.title: 新闻联播Network News
programme.desc: 新闻联播是中国中央电视台于1978年1月1日创办的综合性新闻节目该栏目由中央电视台牵头主办全国各省级电视台合办旨在囊括国内外要闻，宣传党和政府的路线方针政策，反映群众呼声，提供各种重要信息它的收视率雄居中央电视台各档节目的首位，是国内外观众群最庞大影响最广泛的电视新闻栏目

programme.title: 平凡匠心Dreamchaser

programme.title: 世间有她Hero

programme.title: 我老婆系赌圣My Wife is a Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: 一次偶然的机会，阿轮在沙滩救了患上失忆症的盈盈，并招呼她回家中居住盈盈不单美丽性感，还身手了得，帮助阿轮收坏胀，把欺负他的女友打走盈盈心算比计算器还要快，且赌术精湛，麻雀赌波赛马，她无一不精通阿轮深深的爱上了盈盈，向她求婚，可惜在婚礼举行前夕，盈盈突然失踪当阿轮找到她时，原来她已在参加亚洲赌王大赛，对手是无恶不作的赌场大鳄仇曼联，她还有一个未婚夫亨利阿轮呆住了：难道这一趟他又好梦成空？

programme.title: 无间一战Endless Battle
programme.desc: 故事围绕着一对兄弟弟弟是贩毒集团的头目，哥哥健忠则是缉毒组探员，二人不约而同卷入一场毒枭的地盘斗争中一次，健忠在押送毒贩的过程中无意间发现弟弟隐藏着的真正身份一场无间反转的正邪交锋随即展开

programme.title: 别叫我赌神One More Chance

programme.title: 秘密访客Home Sweet Home

programme.title: 赴汤蹈火Relentless Fury

programme.title: 戴假发的人The Wig

programme.title: 迷城Wild City

programme.title: 妈妈!Song of Spring
programme.desc: 85岁妈妈和65岁女儿共同生活，但女儿不幸患上阿尔茨海默氏症，令她记忆力衰退及精神错乱结果年迈的妈妈要重新扛起照顾者的重担，即使如此妈妈仍坚持要与女儿相伴一生

programme.title: 爆裂点Bursting Point

programme.title: CAHAYA TERINDAH EPS 110
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Indah Ranty Maria and her struggle to find her biological family after discovering that she was adopted. She runs away to Jakarta from her adoptive father Jamal, who intends to sell her, and ends up working for the Hendardi family, where she faces romantic conflicts and emotional mysteries from her past.

programme.title: TURUN RANJANG EPS 64
programme.desc: Albi Samuel Zylgwyn is forced to marry his sister-in-law, Naza Rachquel Nesia, at the request of his father-in-law, Wira. This decision is made for the sake of caring for baby Zia Faradilla Yoshi, Albis wife, who falls into a coma after giving birth. This pressured marriage becomes difficult for both Albi and Naza, as they were previously in love with other people.

programme.title: TERIKAT JANJI EPS 64
programme.desc: A drama series that tells the story of Davina, a conglomerates daughter who falls into poverty after being betrayed. She is forced to pretend to be in a relationship with Sena, a ketoprak street vendor. This fake relationship, meant to protect her reputation, becomes complicated when Sena is actually an undercover intelligence agent on a mission tied to his pastfurther intensified by conflicts involving a stepmother and past betrayals.

programme.title: MAHLIGAI UNTUK CINTA 20
programme.desc: Ridho is a simple man from a village who is matched with Mutia, a young woman who shares a similar background. They are close friends with Putri, the daughter of a wealthy family who owns a vegetable company. Their friendship is filled with warmth and happiness, until a major conflict strikes Putri and her family.

programme.title: CURHATAN ORANG DALAM 11
programme.desc: The story revolves around Gendis, a domestic helper working in the Intigraha residential complex. As she goes about her daily life, Gendis interacts with other domestic helpers and becomes involved in the various challenges and conflicts they face with their respective employers.

programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队The Best Team
programme.desc: 全城地图：最强明星队是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗该节目以将城市化为竞技场为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀The Best Team is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 综艺新时代New Style
programme.desc: 综艺新时代，发现台湾好所在三位主持秉持主持职人的精神，以诙谐搞笑的方式，到台湾368个乡镇走透透，把台湾各地专业职人为台湾这片土地所做的努力介绍给观众Spanning all 368 townships of Taiwan, this lively trio shines a light on local craftsmenmasters of their trade whose passion, grit, and love for the land reveal the islands truest charm.

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 追分成功Define Your Own Success
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情友情的同时，也面临得到与失去他们向往完美爱情渴望幸福婚姻追求事业高升，不停向前追分，在这一路跌撞相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的成功！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: Weird, Wild Wonderful
programme.desc: Trek across Africa for a peek at the colorful, quirky survival strategies of its animals. See these furry, feathered, and scaled magicians, from flamboyant flamingos to vanishing lizards, find food, elude predators, and find mates against all odds.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Discover how weirdness is baked into some animals DNA from birth. Check out the bowerbirds funky mate-attracting dance moves, the Christmas Island crabs traffic-dodging prowess, and the sockeye salmons incredible uphill swimming skills.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Look at the supercharged abilities that give some animals an edge in life. Discover fireflies flirty flashes, the tarsiers incredible night vision, the mantis shrimps knockout punch, and the saltwater crocs prey-detecting pressure sensors.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Step into the ring with natures top brawlers, who use violence to get what they need. Watch the cannibalistic Portia spider devour the competition, uncover the bloodthirsty side of cuddly koalas, and catch an epic neck-whipping giraffe battle.

programme.title: Planet Weird Season 1
programme.desc: Get inside the toughest gangs that roam the Earth and see what true grit looks like in the wild. Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal, and meet a flock of finches whove developed a taste for blood.

programme.title: Strange Creatures Season 2
programme.desc: Crawl along with some of the worlds fiercest insects. Watch as giant cockroaches build their immune systems to ensure long life. Then check out the toxic prowess of giant millipedes and the invisibility cloaks of giant prickly stick insects.

programme.title: Coastal Africa Season 1
programme.desc: On Africas east coast, the warm Agulhas run south with a distinctive subtropical landscape. Made up of everything from mangrove swamps to colorful coral reefs, the area has marine turtles - who breed on long and warm sandy beaches - and a recently found population of living fossils, the Coelacanth, which dwell in deep, submarine canyons.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1
programme.desc: Vision its how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1
programme.desc: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

programme.title: Supersenses Season 1
programme.desc: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we cant see, sound we cant hear and even stranger forces we cant begin to detect.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Join researchers as they study how animals communicate. Find out how wolves use their body language to unite the pack and maintain a sophisticated social structure, and see the astounding number of gestures chimps use to communicate.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Tune into the natural world and explore frequencies beyond human hearing, like the gentle hum of giraffes in the evening, or creatures who use song to claim territory on a seemingly silent coral reef.

programme.title: Animals Decoded Season 1
programme.desc: Could undiscovered animal languages save some of our most endangered species? From subtle scents to colors that are invisible to the human eye, uncover the hidden ways creatures communicate, which scientists are only starting to understand.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffes demise becomes a source of life for the regions vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the regions species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the citys shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Surviving the African savanna requires guile and teamwork for species who live in packs. Follow a day in the life of African wild dogs and dwarf mongooses to see how they rely on their tight-knit families to overcome the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: A complex web of relationships rules all life on earth: all species are interconnected, none can survive in isolation. While some relationships are one-sided, others are mutually beneficial. From loose associations to tight-knit partnerships, everything has a place in natures great scheme. Complex interactions between species are not even limited to animals, and some of the best examples occur in the lush mountain forests of Africa.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the worlds 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are natures best lumberjacks explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Watch beginners make their first leap into the air, like an Andean condor who must attend flight school before spreading its wings. Meet oddballs who soar without feathers and marvel at a peregrine falcons speed as it dives to catch its prey.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Take flight with a bee crafting a custom love potion, watch a draco lizard soar to fend off rivals, and witness the graceful pas de deux that bonds a pair of Japanese cranes for life.

programme.title: Airborne Season 1
programme.desc: Plot a course for adventure as animals go on remarkable journeys through the skies. Navigate a wooden labyrinth with a speedy goshawk, join a sandgrouses trek to a distant watering hole, and see a murmuration of starlings mesmerize their nemesis.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Season 1
programme.desc: Descend into the tide pool, where a hermit crab house hunts, a baby catshark runs into strange neighbours, and an octopus terrorises prey. Watch seagulls and other creatures hunt on the surface as the heat rises and oxygen depletes in the pool.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive Season 1
programme.desc: Count down the seconds as the sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in. Persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop, while a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.desc: Ikuti Suffren dan Banni dalam jelajah mereka menikmati makanan-makanan terbaik dari gerai, warung dan kedai kaki lima. Tak lupa juga, cerita-cerita jatuh bangun disebalik setiap peniaga.

Anggara dan Aini merupakan pasangan suami isteri yang hidup bahagia. Namun, menjelang ulang tahun perkahwinan mereka, Aini disahkan menghidap penyakit otak yang menyebabkan dia kehilangan ingatan secara berperingkat sehingga tidak lagi mengenali suaminya sendiri. Dalam tempoh yang semakin singkat, Anggara berusaha mempertahankan cinta mereka sambil menemani Aini menghadapi detik-detik paling sukar dalam hidupnya. Selepas pemergian Aini, sebuah rakaman video yang ditinggalkannya mendedahkan rahsia yang mengubah kehidupan Anggara buat selama-lamanya.

programme.title: Girls Only
programme.desc: Rancangan khas untuk wanita yang memberi tumpuan kepada semua topik, dalam episod ini kami membawa penonton bercamping di Great Women Camp oleh Pajelin Trip, bersenam dengan Malia di Phillip Wain, menggayakan pakaian untuk wanita berhijab dan gadis tidak berhijab di Psychelic Store, dan borak santai bersama Dr. Jerilee Azhari, Pakar Sakit Puan mengenai menstruasi.

programme.title: Trendsetter

programme.title: Sudirman Chow Kit Road
programme.desc: Sudirman Chow Kit Road! merupakan sebuah dokumentari yang mengupas perjalanan dan kenangan nostalgia seorang lelaki berbadan kecil tetapi mempunyai jiwa yang besar, Sudirman Haji Arshad untuk mengadakan konsert percuma yang menyatukan rakyat malaysia berbilang kaum di tengah tengah jalan Chow Kit dan ianya merupakan satu fenomena besar suatu ketika dahulu, sehinggakan ianya masih terpahat di hati rakyat Malaysia

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP2
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Lisa bersama Syamil balik ke kampong untuk membantu Mak Leha menyiasat kejadian anaknya Bayu yang mati selepas dirogol. Mereka singgah di rumah Mbah Hira untuk berjumpa dengan Afifa dan Sarah. Syamil terpaksa meninggalkan mereka selepas di marahi oleh Afifa. Lisa berkongsi maklumat tentang kejadian rogol yang menimpa dirinya, Afifa, Sarah dan Bayu. Nasrun di ugut oleh Azhar, Caryl dan Bakri kerana cuba lari dari kumpulan mereka. Kumpulan perogol membuar perancangan untuk merogol cucu Pak Samad. Mbah Hari marahkan Afifa kerana menggunakan ilmu hitam ke atas Mak Leha, dia berusaha mengubati kaki Mak Leha. Sebaliknya, Afifa meminta sejumpalh wang dari Mak Leha kerana mereka mengubati kaki Mak Leha yang telah menjadi busuk.

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mbah Ngai marahkan Afifa kerana mengugut Mak Leha bagi mendapatkan wang kononnya bagi meyembuhkan kakinya yang busuk. Kumpulan Azhar merancang untuk merogol Siti, cucu kepada Pak Samad dengan menggunakan Nasrun. Nasrun menghadiahkan seutas jam, dia juga menawarkan pekerjaan kepada Pak Samad untuk keluar bekerja di luar kawasan supaya Siti tinggal keseorangan. Nasrun bersama kumpulannya berlakon menyampaikan bantuan kepada penduduk kampong, Lisa ternampak Nasrun yang pernah merogolnya 7 tahun lalu. Dr. Caryl masih berlakon sebagai doktor yang baik untuk membantu Mak Habshah dan Bayu, Nasrun Berjaya menculik Siti lalu di bawa kepada kumpulannya untuk dijadikan sebagai mangsa rogol. Namun Siti sempat melarikan diri sebelum dia dirogol

programme.title: Perempuan Ilmu Hitam EP4
programme.desc: Kumpulan Hunter berjaya menangkap Siti semula, lalu merogolnya. Syamil menunjukkan gambar Nasrun kepadanya Lisa, dia memberitahu Afifa yang dia syak Nasrun dan rakan-rakannya adalah perogol mereka 7 tahun lalu. Afifa menggunakan ilmu hitamnya ke atas Nasrun, namun Mbah Ngai merampas peralatan tersebut. Imbas kembali 7 tahun lalu, Afifa, Sara dan Lisa diserang Kumpulan Hunter yang bertopeng, mereka menculik dan merogol mereka. Lisa keluar bersama Afifa ke rumah kosong lokasi mereka pernah di rogol. Tiba-tiba mereka ternampak Siti terbaring keseorangan. Pada tangan Siti terdapat segumpal rambut perogolnya. Mereka membawa Siti balik untuk berjumpa dengan Pak Samad yang kebetulan baru sampai. Lisa ternampak seutas jam di bilik Siti, kebetulan jam yang sama pernah di terima oleh Lisa satu masa lalu. Manakala Afifa menggunakan sihir ke atas pemilik rambut yang diambil dari tangan Siti. Bakri tiba-tiba muntah darah semasa meraikan kejayaan mereka bersama Caryl dan Azhar

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP15
programme.desc: Alia dan Susan tertangkap. Adam sempat meyelamatkan mereka yang hampir dibunuh Dr Zahir. Zacky turut terselamat manakala Dr Zahir ditahan polis. Ritz yang dalam tahanan lelaki bertopeng dipaksa memanggil Alia datang kelokasi mereka. Lelaki bertopeng memanggil Adam datang kelokasi yang sama. Zacky tiba dilokasi bersama Alia. Berlaku pertarungan antara Zacky dan lelaki bertopeng. Adam menembak kaki lelaki bertopeng untuk menyelamatkan Zacky. Dalam masa yang sama Alia dan Kai pergi menyelamatkan Ritz. Mereka semua terkejut apabila mendapati lelaki bertopeng itu sebenarnya Rafeeq yang juga adik kembar Adam. Mereka berdua bersaing dalam misi membalas dendam terhadap Tan Seri Jalaludin yang telah merampas harta dan membunuh ibu bapa mereka. Adam menembak Rafeeq sebelum menembak Tan Seri Jalaludin. Selepas kejadian Adam meminta Zacky menyerahkanya kepada pihak berkuasa

programme.desc: Mengisahkan dari sudut pandang Kelvin, seorang lelaki yang cuba memahami pasangannya, Mila, menjelang hari perkahwinan mereka. Perbezaan cara berfikir, komunikasi dan harapan antara lelaki dan wanita mencetuskan pelbagai konflik serta situasi lucu. programme.title: Mars Met Venus Part Cewe

Melalui kisah percintaan Mila dan Kelvin, filem ini memaparkan konflik, salah faham serta sisi lucu dalam hubungan pasangan sebelum melangkah ke alam perkahwinan.

programme.title: Mikado
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mikado dan Laetitia, pasangan yang hidup bersama anak-anak mereka, Nuage dan Zphir, dengan cara hidup bebas di dalam van sambil mendidik anak-anak mereka sendiri. Apabila van mereka rosak, mereka terpaksa tinggal sementara di sebuah rumah bersama Vincent dan anak perempuannya. Perubahan gaya hidup ini mula menguji hubungan keluarga, membuka kisah silam serta memaksa mereka memahami erti kestabilan, kasih sayang dan kebahagiaan sebenar.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya Diana Danielle membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya Remy Ishak kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi. Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak, bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.

programme.title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
programme.desc: Irma, seorang wanita karier yang sukses dan banyak menolak lamaran lelaki demi menjaga ayahnya yang ia anggap sebagai pintu menuju surga selepas kematian ibunya. Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: By My Side
programme.desc: Sejak kecil, Faye dan Ben membesar bersama di Subang Jaya dan akhirnya jatuh cinta serta menjalinkan hubungan. Namun hubungan mereka diuji apabila Ben merancang untuk ke Australia, memaksa Faye belajar menghadapi cinta jarak jauh dan kehidupan tanpa dia.

programme.title: La Tahzan
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Viona, seorang wanita Indonesia yang tinggal di Jepun dan bekerja sebagai pengurus rumah kepada keluarga Muslim. Kehidupannya berubah apabila dia bertemu dengan Hasan, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan kisah silam dan rahsia dalam perkahwinannya. Konflik timbul apabila cinta, kepercayaan dan pengorbanan diuji, membawa Viona kepada perjalanan memahami makna kesabaran, keikhlasan dan ketentuan Tuhan.

programme.title: Hello Goodbye
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Indra dan Dara, pasangan muda yang berdepan cabaran dalam hubungan mereka apabila impian, jarak dan masalah peribadi mula menguji kekuatan cinta mereka. Kisah ini mengetengahkan tentang pengorbanan, keluarga, harapan serta erti melepaskan seseorang yang disayangi demi kebahagiaan masing-masing.

programme.title: 29 Februari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Budi, seorang lelaki yang dilahirkan pada 29 Februari 1896 dan hanya meningkat usia setiap empat tahun sekali. Sepanjang hayatnya, Budi menyaksikan pelbagai perubahan zaman dan kehilangan insan tersayang, sehinggalah dia bertemu cinta sejatinya, Lily, yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

Sepanjang pencarian itu, mereka semakin rapat dan tanpa disedari mula menyimpan perasaan antara satu sama lain.

programme.desc: Rindu Bukan Rindu mengisahkan kisah seorang wanita bernama Rindu yang merasa bertuah memiliki seorang lelaki bernama Devan. Kedua-duanya tinggal di Jepun dan menghabiskan masa bersama. Devan sentiasa berada di dekat Rindu, melindungi dan mencintainya. Hubungan di antara mereka terasa sangat rapat dan sempurna. programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: ChatSAT

programme.title: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4
programme.desc: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4 has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. On this new seasons stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of Midlife, Sing Shine! 4.

programme.title: Once A Thief
programme.desc: Put Chai Ko Chow Yun-fat, Jim Leslie Cheung, and Red Bean Cherie Chung are all orphans who become international thieves under the tutelage of their adoptive father Kenneth Tsang. By chance, Put Chai Ko, Jim, and Red Bean learn the whereabouts of a stolen masterpiece, The Maid of Herring, from a Paris museum. Put Chai Ko, determined to complete his mission and retire to marry his girlfriend Red Bean, perishes in a fire during a mission. Years later, Red Bean marries Jim, who has always secretly loved her. Just when she thinks she can finally live a peaceful life, Put Chai Ko suddenly reappears, revealing that theres more to the story...

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: News At 18:30
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: News Magazine 2026 Yes, Boss.
programme.desc: News Perspective is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: You Are Not Alone triumphantly returns! Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing Sammy has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan Priscilla Wong, causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai KK Cheung, Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei Zoie Tam. Gold digger Tong Mei-fun Kamen Kong is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai Daniel Chau and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngais real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.
